items.definition:
A type of fast warship or a sports car.
He dreamed of owning a classic Corvette.

A thing that discourages or is intended to discourage someone from doing something.
The high cost of tuition can be a deterrent for some students.

Money received from the state by unemployed people.
He's been on the dole for six months.

A short period of enjoyment or a brief, casual romantic relationship.
They had a summer fling that ended when she went back to college.

a smooth, continuous movement
The eagle made a graceful glide through the air.

a persistent feeling of ill will or resentment
He held a grudge against his former business partner.

a person who gives information to another
The police received a tip from an anonymous informant.

a foolish or stupid person (informal)
Don't be such a jackass and listen to what I'm saying.

A heavy club, often with a spiked head, used as a weapon; or a spice made from the outer covering of nutmeg.
The knight carried a heavy mace into battle.

The process of arranging marriages or romantic relationships between people.
Her grandmother was known for her excellent matchmaking skills.

An infectious viral disease causing fever and a red rash.
Many children are vaccinated against measles.

A severe headache, often accompanied by nausea and sensitivity to light.
She often suffers from debilitating migraines.

A seasonal prevailing wind in the region of South and Southeast Asia, blowing from the southwest in summer and from the northeast in winter.
The monsoon season brings heavy rains to the region.

The process or technique of selecting, editing, and piecing together separate sections of film or images to form a continuous whole.
The film ended with a montage of the main character's life.

Nothing; zero.
The final score was two-nil to our team.

The action or process of persuading someone or of being persuaded to do or believe something.
He used his powers of persuasion to convince them.

The reproduction of recorded sound or moving images.
The playback quality of the old tape recorder was poor.

The practice of being positive or optimistic.
Her positivity was infectious and brightened everyone's day.

A mechanical device for propelling a boat or aircraft, consisting of a revolving shaft with blades.
The airplane's propeller spun rapidly before takeoff.

the act of organizing something in a new way
The company announced a major reorganization of its departments.

the process of getting something back
Data retrieval from the old server was a slow process.

a person who saves someone or something
He was seen as the saviour of the struggling company.

the business of building ships
The city has a long history of shipbuilding.

a group of three people
A threesome of friends went hiking in the mountains.

a high-pitched voice or sound; a set of three achievements
The singer hit a high treble note.

a competitor thought to have little chance of winning
The team was the underdog, but they still won the championship.

action involving deliberate destruction of or damage to public or private property
The police are investigating the recent acts of vandalism in the park.

a person who goes on a long journey, especially by sea or in space
The ancient voyagers explored new lands across the ocean.

a strange or eccentric person
Some people thought he was a weirdo because of his unusual hobbies.

recognition or acceptance of the truth or existence of something
We received an acknowledgement of our application.

an adversary or opponent
The villain is the main antagonist in the story.

an estimate or rough calculation
This is just an approximation, not an exact figure.

a large mass of ice or mountain
We saw a large berg floating in the ocean.

a temporary suspension of fighting
Both sides agreed to a ceasefire.

a person who works jointly on an activity or project
She is a valuable collaborator on this research project.

funding a project or venture by raising money from a large number of people
They raised enough money through crowdfunding to start their business.

lack of satisfaction
There was widespread dissatisfaction with the new policy.

an increase in intensity or magnitude
The conflict showed signs of rapid escalation.

an executive
The company execs met to discuss the new strategy.

a person who has seen something happen
An eyewitness described the accident to the police.

a factory where metal castings are produced
The old building used to be a metal foundry.

a man armed with a gun
The police are searching for the gunman involved in the robbery.

a person who treats illnesses or disabilities
The village healer used herbs to cure ailments.

an athlete, especially in college or high school
He was a popular jock in high school, always playing sports.

a magic charm or personal influence
He lost his mojo after a series of failures.

the act or process of narrating a story
The documentary featured a clear and engaging narration.

a patient who receives medical treatment without being admitted to a hospital
The clinic treats many outpatients who don't need to stay overnight.

a ruler in ancient Egypt
The pharaohs of Egypt built magnificent pyramids.

a liquid with healing, poisonous, or magical properties
The wizard brewed a powerful potion for healing.

a state of readiness, especially for emergencies
Disaster preparedness is crucial for coastal communities.

a pound sterling (British slang)
Can you lend me a few quid until payday?

the state of being no longer needed or useful; dismissal from employment
The company announced several redundancies due to restructuring.

the act of electing someone again
The president is campaigning hard for reelection.

a deterioration in someone's state of health after a temporary improvement
After months of sobriety, he suffered a relapse.

great enjoyment; a condiment eaten with food
She ate her meal with great relish.

an activity pursued in addition to one's main occupation; the area out of bounds along the side of a sports field
He earns extra money from his sideline as a freelance writer.

the formation of mental images
Data visualization helps us understand complex information.

an examination of tissue removed from a living body
The doctor recommended a biopsy to check the lump.

a member of a military unit trained for raids
The commandos launched a surprise attack.

the loss or removal of water
Symptoms of dehydration include thirst and dizziness.

the process of filtering something
Water purification involves several stages of filtration.

partial or total darkness; a feeling of melancholy
A sense of gloom filled the room after the bad news.

a person who operates a gun, especially a large one
The gunner aimed the cannon at the target.

a magic spell; a curse
She believed someone had put a hex on her.
